bioconda.name: panhog
bioconda.description:
PanHOG classifies and annotates Hierarchical Orthologous Groups (HOGs) in
pangenomic datasets into core / shell / private compartments, then re-weights
and validates the classification with the species tree, per-HOG gene trees,
codon-based dN/dS selection, and functional annotation, producing
publication-ready figures from an OrthoFinder N0.tsv plus per-accession FASTA.
